# Aceray – Commercial Seating & Contract Table Catalog

> Aceray presents interior designers, architects, and hospitality procurement specialists with unique contemporary seating, armchairs, lounge seating, barstools, and custom table designs from international artisans.

## Brand Identity & Manufacturing Standards
- **Primary Domain**: https://aceray.com
- **Live Catalog & Staging**: https://aceray.netlify.app
- **Target Audience**: Contract Interior Designers, Architects (A&D), Hospitality Procurement Managers, Hotel & Restaurant Operators.
- **Manufacturing Excellence**: Crafted by master European artisans using kiln-dried solid hardwoods (beech and oak dried to 6–8% moisture content), precision steel and aluminum bases, and contract-grade finishes.
- **Durability Standards**: BIFMA tested and certified. Static and dynamic weight ratings range from 400 lbs to 500+ lbs.
- **Joinery Engineering**: Corner-blocked mortise-and-tenon wood joinery and fully welded single-unit metal frames engineered to withstand high-traffic commercial environments.
- **Upholstery & Foam Specifications**: Contract upholstery rated from 30,000 up to 100,000+ double rubs (Wyzenbeek method). Commercial-grade molded polyurethane foam (1.8 to 2.5 lb density) for lasting shape retention.

---

## Product Categories & Offerings

### 1. Dining & Side Chairs (`/catalog?cat=side-chairs`)
- **Description**: Lightweight yet robust commercial dining chairs designed for high-turn restaurants, corporate cafeterias, and hospitality venues.
- **Key Features**: Solid wood frames, catalyzed clear lacquer finishes, stackable models (6 to 10 high), ergonomic backs.
- **Popular Models**: Arte, Alba, Ciao, Solo-V, Bora, Mira, Corso, Spazio.

### 2. Commercial Armchairs (`/catalog?cat=armchairs`)
- **Description**: Premium upholstered and wood-frame armchairs providing superior comfort for fine dining, executive conference rooms, and upscale lounges.
- **Key Features**: Supportive armrests, mortise-and-tenon construction, COM/COL upholstery tailoring.

### 3. Hospitality Lounge & Swivel Seating (`/catalog?cat=lounge`)
- **Description**: Deep-seat lounge chairs, club armchairs, and executive swivel seating for hotel lobbies, airport lounges, and cocktail venues.
- **Key Features**: Molded polyurethane foam, heavy-duty 360-degree or auto-return swivel ball-bearing bases, high double-rub contract fabrics.

### 4. Commercial Barstools & Counter Stools (`/catalog?cat=barstools`)
- **Description**: Ergonomic barstools (30" seat height for 42" bar counters) and counter stools (24" seat height for 36" counters).
- **Key Features**: Integrated stainless steel or brass protective heel kickplates, fully welded steel/aluminum frames, backless and backed configurations.

### 5. Contract Table Tops & Base Systems (`/catalog?cat=tables`)
- **Description**: Anti-wobble commercial table base systems and high-durability tops.
- **Key Features**: Heavy cast iron and steel base plates with adjustable leveling glides, solid wood tops, compact laminates, and weather-resistant Extrema tops.

### 6. Outdoor Living Collections (`/catalog?cat=outdoors`)
- **Description**: All-weather outdoor dining chairs, armchairs, lounge seating, and patio tables for resort pools, outdoor dining decks, and coastal venues.
- **Key Features**: Corrosion-resistant aluminum alloy frames, 2+ mil baked powder-coat finishes, UV-inhibited synthetic weaves, quick-drain reticulated foam cushions.

---

## Trade & Architectural Services
- **Customization**: Custom wood stain matching, custom powder-coat metal colors, Customer’s Own Material (COM), and Customer’s Own Leather (COL).
- **A&D Downloads**: Downloadable spec sheets, 2D/3D CAD files, Revit BIM objects, and high-resolution material finish swatches available on product detail pages.
- **Ordering & Quotes**: Request a catalog or commercial quote directly at https://aceray.com/contact or via sales representatives.
